text:
Cheers floor staff,
The night supervisor asked me to write about hand-off notes

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk hand-off clear, calm, and complete so the next shift can continue without delay. Include any animal sensitivities, crate checks, feeding instructions, and traveler concerns in plain language. If a case involves special handling, note what was already done and what still needs attention, and make sure the record stays respectful and easy to follow.

For any pet moving through the quarantine area, record the condition of the kennel, whether the animal settled well, and whether any extra care is needed before release. <<FACT F026>> Add only the facts that support safe transfer, and avoid informal shorthand that could confuse the next handler. If you spoke with the traveler, keep the summary brief and professional, and note any promised follow-up so it is not missed.

For the skyport intake side, confirm that all arrival paperwork is matched to the animal, the carrier is secure, and the welfare check is complete before the case is passed on. <<FACT F008>> If a pet relief stop was arranged, note the access details and any guidance the traveler should receive on arrival. <<FACT F018>> Please send along any unusual observation at once, even if it seems minor, because early notice helps us keep the process safe and smooth. Thank you for keeping the hand-off dependable and respectful.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
